title: prefill/decode: kernel scheduling + KV-cache + continuous batching improvements (chunked & speculative prefill, stage overlap)
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: The prefill->decode pipeline still has inefficiencies that hurt tail latency and throughput for mixed-length workloads. This PR combines several orthogonal optimizations: (1) chunked prefill to break long prefill sequences into cache-friendly chunks, (2) speculative prefill to overlap token generation with prefill work where safe, (3) stage overlap to run prefill, KV-store updates, and decode kernels in a pipelined fashion, and (4) scheduling and kernel-selection heuristics to prefer low-latency kernels for short sequences while grouping long-running work for throughput kernels. Also includes KV-cache locality improvements and continuous-batching changes to reduce per-token overhead.

What changed (high level):
- Implemented chunked prefill execution path and miss/retry logic for KV cache boundaries.
- Added speculative prefill mode that issues decode work for top-K candidates while later prefill chunks are still in flight (configurable guardrails to preserve correctness).
- Introduced stage-overlap scheduler which maps prefill chunk, KV update, and decode launch to distinct CUDA streams and coordinates via lightweight host-side futures.
- Kernel selection heuristics: fast-path kernels for <64 token sequences, throughput kernels for long contexts. Heuristics are aware of current batch composition.
- KV-cache locality: batched KV writes and compacted index layout to reduce memory traffic for chunked prefill.
- Continuous batching: lower per-call overhead by reusing command buffers and coalescing small decode requests.
- Added end-to-end performance tests and microbenchmarks.

Benchmarks (internal):
- 8k-context mixed workload: 12% throughput improvement, 9% median latency reduction, 18% P99 tail latency improvement.
- 2k short-requests heavy tail: 8% median latency reduction, 6% P95 reduction.
- Prefill-heavy scenarios: up to 25% reduction in GPU memory traffic from KV locality changes.

Compatibility and flags: New behavior is behind runtime feature flags (prefill_chunking, speculative_prefill, stage_overlap_scheduler) and defaults to off for private deployments until validated. The heuristics are runtime-configurable per model profile.

Notes: This PR is intentionally conservative about correctness; speculative prefill is gated and includes a deterministic fallback when mismatch is detected. See tests/perf/prefill_decode_bench.py for validation harness.

review_comments: Samir Gupta (reviewer): Can you clarify the correctness model for speculative prefill? What happens when the speculative decode picks a different next token than the final prefill?

Maya Chen (author): Speculative prefill uses a conservative top-K expansion with a guardrail: if the final prefill outcome is not within the speculative set we detect the mismatch at decode commit and replay the minimal affected decode work. We add counters and a mismatch metric; the default top-K for speculative is 3 in CI. The fallback replay cost is upper-bounded and measured in bench results.
Priya Nair (reviewer): The stage-overlap scheduler introduces more CUDA streams; did you observe any degredation for small GPU configs (1 GPU/low SM)?

Maya Chen (author): We added a heuristic to collapse streams on single-GPU small-SM configs to avoid context switching overhead. Benchmarks for small instances are included in the perf job and show neutral-to-positive results.
Luca Rossi (reviewer): Can you add a unit test to assert no deadlocks when a KV write is delayed by OOM/memory pressure?

Maya Chen (author): Added tests/integration/test_prefill_speculative.py which injects a simulated KV backpressure path and asserts correct retry/fallback behavior. Also added a CI perf test which runs with simulated memory pressure in a smaller profile.
Theo Brown (approver): Verified perf numbers on our internal canary cluster (runnable via ci/perf-workflow.yaml). Approving pending changelog entry and small doc clarifications.
Maya Chen (author): Added docs/perf/prefill_decode_optimizations.md and updated CHANGELOG.md with the feature flags and defaults.
